latin: De distinctione ex natura rei non debent discordare Thomistae et Scotistae, si suos doctores fundamentaliter intelligant.
translation: On the distinction arising from the nature of the thing, Thomists and Scotists should not disagree, if they understand their own doctors at a fundamental level.
